finding.text: Each moved method's doc comment now sits in two places: above the one-line forwarder in `Page.class.js` (e.g. lines 219, 462) and above the moved body in `Listing.js`/`Load.js`. That is why the brief's line check does not agree (Page.class.js −97/+13 = 84 net, against 114 lines moved). Keep the full comment in one place, and give the forwarder a short pointer or nothing.
`doc/split-statics.mjs:33` does nothing: `text.replace(..., (m) => m)` hands back the same string. Delete the line.
`core/Page/readme.md:5` still says "the 23 small files beside it"; with `Load.js` added, that count is one short. `doc/classes.md` got its `Load.js` row, so the file list itself is current.

The `Page` versus `this` choice was checked one method at a time and holds. `from` passes `this` (it calls `new P`, `P.read_json`, `P.props` and `P.from`, so a subclass keeps its own kind). `load` passes `Page` (so `instanceof P` is still `instanceof Page`). The listing memos (`P.listings`, `P.loaded_listings`, `P.log_pages`) still land on `Page`. Neither new file imports `Page.class.js`. `is` comes from `View.js`, which exports it at line 476. `node --check` passes on all three files.
